name: Android Automotive Reference EV (Vehicle HAL only)
class: Battery-electric car whose only app-visible data path is the Android Vehicle HAL
interfaces: Android Vehicle HAL properties (speed, steering, odometer, outside temperature, battery energy, range, charge rate, ignition, charge state, tyre pressures, gear)
notes: On Android Automotive an app sees the vehicle only through CarPropertyManager (the Vehicle HAL); the property ids and units are the AOSP standard, so Vantage needs no decoder file for this model.
